name: @zhujiuyi/dsh-mcpserver-manager
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: manage every configured MCP server in one place — inspect connection state and the tools each server provides, preflight a server before saving it (missing executables, npm package names used as commands, unexpanded variables, unreachable URLs), add servers from a dsh patch string or a Claude Code mcpServers JSON block, and edit one server without touching the rest. · DSH 插件：集中管理已配置的 MCP 服务，保存前预检配置（可执行文件缺失、把包名当命令、变量未展开、URL 异常等），支持 dsh 片段或 Claude Code mcpServers JSON 新增，并可单独编辑某个服务。

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client/client.js && node --check src/parse.mjs && node --check src/patch-edit.mjs && node --check src/inventory.mjs
